name: timeline-v
description: 时间线：垂直三节点（线擦下 + 节点点亮），里程碑/流程
css: #tpl-timeline-v { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 0 8vw; background: var(--ground, #0a0a1a); } .tv-title { font-size: 4vh; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 4vh; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); } .tv-line { position: relative; padding-left: 4vh; } .tv-spine { position: absolute; left: 1.6vh; top: 1vh; bottom: 1vh; width: 2px; background: currentColor; opacity: .35; transform-origin: top center; } .tv-node { position: relative; margin: 2.6vh 0; font-size: 2.6vh; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); opacity: 0; } .tv-node::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -3.4vh; top: .6vh; width: 1.8vh; height: 1.8vh; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); }
body:
{{title}}
{{s1}}
{{s2}}
{{s3}}
timeline: tl.fromTo("{tpl} .tv-spine", { scaleY: 0 }, { scaleY: 1, duration: 0.7, ease: "power2.inOut" }, {start} + 0.2);tl.fromTo("{tpl} .tv-title", { y: 34, opacity: 0 }, { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.5 }, {start});tl.fromTo("{tpl} .tv-node", { opacity: 0, x: -26 }, { opacity: 1, x: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: "power2.out", stagger: 0.3 }, {start} + 0.45);
